remarks: Interior photos coming soon !  Nestled in the sought-after "Behind the Y" neighborhood, this special 4-bedroom, 3-full-bath home sits on a beautifully flat and open acre-ideal for outdoor enjoyment and entertaining. With 3,656 square feet of well-designed living space, it offers a perfect blend of generous entertaining areas and comfortable private retreats. Walk to all three schools, Waveny Park, and downtown New Canaan. Conveniently located near the Merritt Parkway and close to the Darien border, this home combines charm, community, and accessibility. Offered furnished or unfurnished for the 2025-2026 school year or beyond, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy flexibility and comfort in one of New Canaan's most desirable neighborhoods.
